title: Forklift Driver Klaus English Subtitles
summary: An English-subtitled German workplace safety film about forklift driver Klaus. It is campy and darkly comic, staging an escalating series of forklift accidents.
why: Mostly used as a joke reference whenever forklifts, safety or dying on the job come up, with one commenter calling it a funny and bloody case for warehouse safety.

quote.text: this video answered every question I’ve ever had about why warehouse safety is such a big deal.
